kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تشلون (form I)
# تَشَلُّونَ (tašallūna) /ta.ʃal.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of شَلَّ (šalla)
# تَشُلُّونَ (tašullūna) /ta.ʃul.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of شَلَّ (šalla)
# تُشَلُّونَ (tušallūna) /tu.ʃal.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
